rows.grounds: karmāntaṃ = until the end of the rite (accusative singular)
bhavitavyaṃ = it must be (gerundive, neuter nominative singular)
śivājñayā = by Śiva's command (instrumental singular, compound: śiva+ājñā)
tryakṣare = in the three-syllable (locative singular, compound: tri+akṣara)
nirṛtiprāye = mostly belonging to Nirṛti (locative singular, compound: nirṛti+prāya)
bhoḥśabdamekakam = one single word 'bhoḥ' (nominative singular, compound: bhoḥ+śabda+ekaka)
